jobs.title: Product Manager, Simulation (Mid-Senior)
jobs.description:
About Revel
At Revel, we are revolutionizing the way the world's most critical hardware is controlled — across aerospace, automotive, energy, robotics, defense, and advanced manufacturing sectors. Our next-generation software stack combines an intuitive command/control interface, a specialized programming language tailored for hardware control, and a high-performance runtime environment. We empower engineers to build, test, and deploy critical systems rapidly, reliably, and safely.

Our simulation tooling is a core part of that story — enabling engineers to model, validate, and understand the behavior of complex systems before they ever touch real hardware.

Role Overview
We are hiring a Product Manager to own and evolve our simulation product. This position sits at the intersection of deeply technical simulation capabilities and a platform-wide product experience.

This role is for someone who has operated in technically complex product spaces and knows how to balance depth with usability. Simulation tools are not like typical software products: the physics, numerics, and modeling paradigms underneath carry real weight, and the Product Manager who succeeds here will be someone who can engage with that depth, communicate it clearly, and translate it into a product that feels intuitive across both novice and expert users.

You will be working directly with early design partners to shape what our simulation product becomes, integrating it tightly with the broader Revel platform. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role delivering on tight timelines and aggressive milestones.

What You'll Do

 - Work directly with early customers and beta users to conduct deep discovery — understanding their workflows, pain points, and mental models at a high level of fidelity.

 - Translate that feedback into clearly scoped product requirements, not just a list of feature requests.

 - Own roadmap planning for the simulation product and communicate priorities across engineering, design, and customer stakeholders.

 - Serve as the internal bridge between the simulation team and the broader Revel platform, ensuring sim integrates seamlessly into the overall product experience.

 - Partner closely with design and front-end engineering to craft an experience that feels modern and intuitive without sacrificing depth.

 - Work cross-functionally with marketing to support major product launches.

 - Manage stakeholder expectations up and across the organization.

 - Advocate clearly for what you believe is right for the product, even when that means pushing back.

Must-Have Experience

 - 4+ years of product management experience, or highly relevant adjacent experience.

 - Prior experience as a software or systems engineer.

 - Experience managing or contributing to a technically deep product — e.g. FEM/CFD simulation tools, CAD/3D modeling, robotics simulation, or electrical design tools.

 - Proven ability to conduct rigorous, high-fidelity customer discovery — not just collecting feature requests, but uncovering real user needs.

 - Experience operating in a "1 to N" product phase: taking an existing product through validation, integration, and scaled launch.

 - Strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across engineering, design, and marketing.

 - Mission-driven mindset with strong ownership over outcomes.

Plusses

 - Background in or strong familiarity with physics, mechanical engineering, or electrical engineering.

 - Direct engineering experience working on simulation products or tools.

 - Background in aerospace, defense, robotics, advanced manufacturing, energy, or automotive industries.

 - Experience simulating or operating systems in a fast-paced hardware testing environment.

 - Experience collaborating closely with a marketing function on a major product launch.

 - Experience at a technical-product organization building tools for engineers or scientists.

Team & Exposure
You will work alongside a dedicated simulation team and collaborate closely with the Revel platform's design and front-end engineering teams. You will have direct exposure to the Head of Product and CEO, and will work hands-on with customers operating real, high-stakes hardware systems. Our feedback loops are tight — you will see directly how your decisions shape real-world use.

Why Revel

 - Work on software that directly shapes how engineers interact with critical real-world systems.

 - Join a deeply technical team building next-generation hardware control infrastructure.

 - High ownership and visibility from day one.

 - Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.

 - Help define what simulation in the hands of hardware engineers should actually feel like.

Benefits

 - Health insurance — We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage to support you and your family.

 - 401(k) — Save for your future with our 401(k) plan.

 - Equity — All full-time employees receive equity, ensuring that you share in Revel's success and growth.

 - Life insurance — Company-paid life insurance gives you and your family peace of mind.

 - Parental leave — We offer paid maternity and paternity leave to support new parents.

 - Catered lunch — We provide catered lunch five days a week, so you can stay fueled and focused.

 - Unlimited PTO — We trust you to take the time you need. Unlimited PTO for all full-time employees.

ITAR Requirements
To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/ddtc_public?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Reporting and Analytics
jobs.description:
About Revel
 Revel builds software that interfaces directly with complex physical systems — across aerospace, robotics, energy, and advanced manufacturing.

We are building infrastructure where software decisions have real-world consequences. The problems are hard, the systems are complex, and the bar is high.

The Role
 We're hiring a Product Manager to own the reporting and analytics layer of the Revel platform.

Everything our customers do in Revel produces data — thousands of channels of telemetry, sampled fast, across long-running tests and live operations. The platform already captures all of it. This role owns what customers can do with it: how they review it, make sense of it, and act on what they find.

The area has strong customer pull and no settled definition inside the platform. You'll be deciding what gets built, not maintaining a roadmap someone else wrote.

What You'll Do

 - Own product direction for how customers work with the data their systems produce — from ambiguous problem space to shipped product

 - Work laterally across teams, partnering with engineering stakeholders to align on user experience and persona

 - Use the product the way customers do — work with real test data yourself — so your product judgment comes from firsthand use, not secondhand summary

 - Translate complex, technical workflows into simple, intuitive interfaces

 - Spend real time with users: test engineers, controls engineers, and the people who sign off on results. Understand how they work with data today and what questions their conclusions have to answer

 - Collaborate directly with Head of Product and CEO

Who You Are

 - You've built and shipped technical, data-heavy products and care about the quality of what ships, not just that it shipped

 - You're comfortable working with engineers who operate deep in systems, infrastructure, or highly technical domains

 - You can go from user problem → product concept → shipped experience

 - You don't need fully defined requirements to get started

 - You care about product quality and user experience, not just delivery

Must-Haves

 - 4-8 years of Product Management Experience

 - Experience with big data analytics and reporting products

 - Experience taking user feedback and synthesizing it into deliverables

 - Experience coordinating engineers to execute on a product vision

 - Track record of building internal alignment for engineering/product initiatives

 - Hands-on experience with analytics workflows

 - Engineering degree

Plusses

 - Experience building or working on software for hardware systems

 - Experience in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering

 - Experience with complex, interactive software (e.g. CAD, simulation environments)

 - Exposure to systems with non-trivial underlying models or logic

 - Ability to bridge deeply technical backend work with user-facing product

 - Experience working across a wide range of users — from experts to first-time users

 - Frontend or design capability (React, TypeScript, or similar) — able to prototype and iterate independently

 - Familiarity with a data query language (e.g., SQL)

Tools & Technologies

 - Ticketing systems (e.g., Jira)

 - Project planning tools

 - Data query languages (a plus)

Why This Role

 - You'll own the reporting and analytics category end-to-end — not just execute against someone else's specs

 - You'll work on problems that don't have existing playbooks

 - You'll operate close to the core of the system — not at the edges

 - You'll help define an entirely new category of software for complex physical systems

jobs.description:
ABOUT REVEL


At Revel, we are revolutionizing the way the world's most critical hardware is controlled — across aerospace, automotive, energy, robotics, defense, and advanced manufacturing sectors. Our next-generation software stack combines an intuitive command/control interface, a specialized programming language tailored for hardware control, and a high-performance runtime environment. We empower engineers to build, test, and deploy critical systems rapidly, reliably, and safely.

Our simulation tooling is a core part of that story — enabling engineers to model, validate, and understand the behavior of complex systems before they ever touch real hardware.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We are hiring a Product Manager to define and own our hardware integration product — the areas of the platform that enable test engineers to configure, integrate, and manage their hardware systems and device channels (sensors, DAQ inputs/outputs, signal types, scaling) for data acquisition and testing.

This is a technical product for technical operators. The people using this product are test engineers configuring real hardware for real experiments, not consumers — and empathizing with their workflows without an engineering or test background is close to impossible. We need someone who has either done this work themselves or built software for people who do.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Define the product vision and roadmap for hardware configuration and management, including addressing systems of increasing complexity as Revel breaks into new industries

 - Conduct deep discovery with test engineers and technical operators to understand how they configure channels today, where the friction is, and what a genuinely fast workflow looks like.

 - Benchmark rigorously against best-in-class tools, and be explicit about where we need to match, and where we can be meaningfully better.

 - Partner closely with design and engineering to build a user experience that respects expert users rather than a simplified consumer-style interface that slows them down.

 - Translate discovery and benchmarking into clearly scoped requirements.

 - Own roadmap planning and sequencing, and communicate priorities and tradeoffs clearly to engineering, design, and leadership.

 - Serve as the internal bridge between hardware config and the rest of the platform, ensuring it integrates cleanly rather than existing as a bolted-on tool.

 - Work cross-functionally with marketing to support launches.

 - Advocate clearly for what the product needs, including when that means pushing back on scope pressure before the fundamentals are solid.
   
   


MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of product management experience, or direct experience as a test engineer or software engineer building tools for test/measurement workflows.

 - Demonstrated ability to define a product from a blank slate — building a first roadmap and requirements set, not just refining an existing one.

 - Proven ability to conduct rigorous, high-fidelity customer discovery with technical users, and to translate their workflows into scoped product requirements.

 - A strong point of view on UX for expert tools.

 - Strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across engineering, design, and marketing.

 - Mission-driven mindset with strong ownership over outcomes.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Firsthand familiarity with hardware test and data acquisition workflows: sensors, DAQ hardware, channel configuration, signal scaling, or equivalent instrumentation work.

 - Direct experience as a test engineer working with DAQ or instrumentation hardware (NI, Keysight, Vector, or similar).

 - Hands-on familiarity with FlexLogger, LabVIEW, TestStand, DIAdem, or comparable test/measurement software — as a user, not just an observer.

 - Background in physics, mechanical engineering, or electrical engineering.

 - Experience building tools for engineers or scientists in aerospace, defense, robotics, advanced manufacturing, energy, or automotive.

 - Experience operating in a fast-paced hardware testing environment.

 - Experience collaborating closely with a marketing function on a major product launch.
   
   


TEAM & EXPOSURE

You will work alongside the engineering team building this product and collaborate closely with the platform's design and front-end engineering teams. You will have direct exposure to the Head of Product and CEO, and will work hands-on with the technical operators who will actually use what you build. Our feedback loops are tight — you will see directly how your product decisions land with real users doing real, high-stakes work.

About Revel

Our next-generation software stack combines an intuitive command/control interface, a specialized programming language tailored for hardware control, and a high-performance runtime environment. Role Overview

We are seeking a Product Marketing Manager to shape how the market understands and adopts Revel. This role owns positioning and messaging for Revel's product suite, drives adoption of new capabilities through launches and enablement, and builds the content that proves our value to technical and executive buyers. You will translate complex technical capabilities into narratives and assets that make Revel the platform of choice for critical hardware operations.

You will own product launches end to end, arm sales with the collateral and proof points they need to close deals, and build content, case studies, and thought leadership that establish Revel as the leader in hardware-agnostic test and control software.


What You'll Do

Product & Feature Launches

 - Own the launch process for new products and features: define positioning, messaging, and go-to-market plans, and coordinate cross-functionally to hit agreed targets for adoption, activation, and usage within a defined window after launch.

 - Translate roadmap investments into business outcomes by working closely with product and engineering to understand what's shipping and why it matters to customers.

 - Build launch assets: release notes, landing pages, in-product messaging, demo scripts, and internal briefs that get the field ready to sell new capabilities.

Sales Enablement

 - Build and maintain sales collateral (one-pagers, battlecards, competitive positioning, ROI narratives) that helps the sales team win deals and progress pipeline.

 - Partner with sales leadership (Robert, Cole, Hunter) to identify gaps in enablement and close them with targeted content and training.

 - Develop vertical-specific positioning (e.g. nuclear, aerospace) and proof points anchored in verified customer evidence.

Content & Thought Leadership

 - Own a content calendar spanning case studies, blogs, product announcements, and thought leadership that builds Revel's reputation and share of voice in its core markets.

 - Partner with customers and engineers to draft case studies and testimonials that demonstrate real-world impact, with no claims beyond what's verified.

 - Work with engineers to translate technical updates into content for both technical and executive audiences.

Cross-functional Collaboration

 - Report to the Director of Product Marketing, and work closely with design, product, sales, and test engineers.

 - Partner with designers on visual assets and with product teams on launch timing and scope.

 - Track and report on impact: share of voice, launch adoption metrics, and pipeline contribution from content.

What we are looking for

 - 3-5 years in product marketing, with direct experience owning product or feature launches (exceptional candidates with less experience and strong fit will be considered).

 - Proven ability to write and position for a technical domain (aerospace, defense, engineering, industrial software, or similar "hard tech" space).

 - Clear understanding of how launches, content, and enablement fit into a broader marketing funnel and business strategy.

 - High capacity to learn a complex technical domain quickly and turn it into credible, differentiated positioning.

Bonus Points

 - Previous experience at a high-growth startup or in the aerospace/defense/nuclear industry.

 - Background in technical writing, PR, or executive communications.

 - Experience managing corporate social channels and building an audience.

Why Revel

 - You will report directly to the Director of Product Marketing, with close collaboration across design, product, sales, and test engineering. 

 - This role offers direct exposure to the front lines of hardware testing, including time (virtual and occasionally on-site) at facilities like rocket engine test stands and nuclear reactor sites. 

 - Competitive salary, substantial equity, and fast personal growth in a deeply technical career

 - Small, ambitious team where your impact is immediate and visible

Join us to redefine what’s possible in software for hardware.
